core.headline: Extended four-bedroom detached house on 0.3-acre plot
core.summary: Extended family home in Sevenoaks with kitchen/family room, double garage and generous 0.3-acre plot. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms, two reception rooms, driveway parking and gas central heating.
core.listing:
This four-bedroom detached house stands on a 0.3-acre plot on Beech Avenue in Sevenoaks. The property was built in 1968 and has been extended to provide a kitchen/family room.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms and the extended kitchen/family room. The double garage provides additional storage and workspace.

Four bedrooms are arranged over the first floor, served by two bathrooms. 

The plot extends to 0.3 acres and includes the rear garden. Parking is provided on the driveway.

Beech Avenue is in Sevenoaks TN13.

Guide Price £850,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known. Japanese knotweed found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025; herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee.
keyFeatures: Gas central heating and mains services
